title: LEEQualificationDTO
description: LEEQualificationDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

qualificationTestDate.description: End date of the initial LEE qualifying test or a retest.

parameterCode.description: Parameter code associated with the LEE qualification.

qualificationTestType.description: Indication of whether the qualifying test was an initial test or retest.

potentialAnnualHgMassEmissions.description: Potential annual Hg mass emissions used for LEE qualification.

applicableEmissionStandard.description: Applicable Emission Standard used for LEE qualification.

unitsOfStandard.description: units of the Applicable Emission Standard.

percentageOfEmissionStandard.description: Result of initial test or retest as a percentage of the Applicable Emission Standard.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring qualification LEE record.

qualificationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring qualification record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.
